resources.string: Shows when the agent governance kernel is active
Oak & Sparrow reviews every action an AI agent proposes on your behalf before it executes. Actions are scored, and risky ones are held for your review.
To verify that agent actions actually completed as reported, we need accessibility service access. This lets us confirm outcomes without trusting the agent\'s self-reports.
To show governance decisions over other apps, we need overlay permission. This will be used for the trusted status display in a future update.
